title: Lesson 6: Estimating Multi-Week Engagements: Beyond the 30-45 Minute Task
description: The 30-45 minute task is the unit of execution, not the unit of estimation. This lesson teaches you to size a real multi-week delivery: how to break a large engagement into estimable pieces, why you estimate the critical path and not the total, how to put the constraints and reviews from Lesson 5 into the number, and how to keep an estimate honest when the environment reveals surprises.
